_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Asbestos Waste Documentation
summary: The Asbestos Waste Documentation provides the Government with tracking, shipping, and disposal information on the Government generator's asbestos waste.
use_relationship:
The Asbestos Waste Documentation will provide the Government with tracking, shipping, and disposal information on the Government generator's asbestos waste. Asbestos waste and any asbestos containing daughter waste products originating from asbestos waste shall be tracked until disposed.
This data item description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the discrete task request as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Asbestos Waste Documentation shall be submitted in format of Sample Figure 1.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Asbestos Waste Documentation shall include all content in Sample Figure 1. The contractor shall include the Identification (ID) number that begins with "R" and followed by seven digits. The contractor shall include the Project ID number on all copies of the applicable waste shipment record(s) accompanying asbestos waste and any asbestos containing daughter waste products resulting from processing/disposal of asbestos wastes.
